name: flashinfer_contest_l1_043_mla_qkv_split
author: flashinfer
description: DeepSeek-V3 MLA QKV split: bf16 q_a -> FlashInfer rmsnorm -> q_b -> split nope/pe; kv_a -> split compressed/k_pe. No kv_b in this task.

sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import flashinfer.norm as fn

NUM_HEADS = 128
QK_NOPE = 128
QK_ROPE = 64
Q_HEAD_DIM = 192
KV_LORA = 512


@torch.no_grad()
def run(hidden_states, q_a_proj_weight, q_a_layernorm_weight,
        q_b_proj_weight, kv_a_proj_weight, rms_norm_eps):
    b, s, h = hidden_states.shape

    q_a = F.linear(hidden_states, q_a_proj_weight)  # (b, s, Q_LORA)
    q_a_flat = q_a.reshape(-1, q_a.shape[-1]).contiguous()
    q_a_normed = fn.rmsnorm(q_a_flat, q_a_layernorm_weight, rms_norm_eps)
    q = F.linear(q_a_normed, q_b_proj_weight).view(b, s, NUM_HEADS, Q_HEAD_DIM)
    q_nope = q[..., :QK_NOPE].contiguous()
    q_pe = q[..., QK_NOPE:].contiguous()

    kv = F.linear(hidden_states, kv_a_proj_weight)
    compressed_kv = kv[..., :KV_LORA].contiguous()
    k_pe = kv[..., KV_LORA:].view(b, s, 1, QK_ROPE).contiguous()

    return q_nope, q_pe, compressed_kv, k_pe
